title: common.sh should refuse a failing declared-image read, not swallow it
description:
image/common.sh repo_setup still runs `ticfac sandbox image --declared-only ... 2>/dev/null || declared=""`. After tick bib the only nonzero path is a malformed .tick/runners.toml, which the next line (ticfac sandbox setup) refuses with EXIT_SETUP — so the check is not skippable today — but the swallow means any future regression of the verb would silently disable the declared-image check again. Making the line die with EXIT_SETUP on a nonzero exit would close that hole by construction.
evidence: image/common.sh:1106

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding 39381dbefbbab23a1bf7287b6f3b6319fc82a4410410c0c69bd7666b5bc25813 (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-bib/attempt-13): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/39381dbefbbab23a1bf7287b6f3b6319fc82a4410410c0c69bd7666b5bc25813.json on the run branch.
